alt.zh-CN: 图片的替代文本；文字头像上它是可访问名称，未设置时使用头像的文字内容。
alt.en-US: Alternative text of the image. On a text avatar it is the accessible name, falling back to the avatar text when unset.

border.zh-CN: 额外边框，传 `true` 或 `{ color, motion }`；`motion` 为 `true` 时开启边框动效。
border.en-US: Additional border: `true` or `{ color, motion }`; `motion: true` enables the border animation.

bottomSlot.zh-CN: 底部标记配置，包含 `shape`、`text`、`bgColor`、`textColor`、`className` 和 `style`；传入 `render` 时完全由它渲染。仅在 `extra-small` 至 `extra-large` 的预设尺寸下显示。
bottomSlot.en-US: Bottom badge configuration: `shape`, `text`, `bgColor`, `textColor`, `className` and `style`; a `render` function replaces the whole badge. Shown only at the preset sizes from `extra-small` to `extra-large`.

children.zh-CN: 头像内的文字或自定义内容。
children.en-US: Text or custom content inside the avatar.

className.zh-CN: 头像主体元素（`.semi-avatar`）的类名；使用额外边框或顶部、底部标记时，它位于外层包裹元素之内。
className.en-US: Class name of the avatar element (`.semi-avatar`); when a border or a top or bottom badge is used, it sits inside the outer wrapper.

color.zh-CN: 头像的预设背景颜色，可选 `amber`、`blue`、`cyan`、`green`、`grey`、`indigo`、`light-blue`、`light-green`、`lime`、`orange`、`pink`、`purple`、`red`、`teal`、`violet`、`yellow`；图片头像不使用。
color.en-US: Preset background color: `amber`, `blue`, `cyan`, `green`, `grey`, `indigo`, `light-blue`, `light-green`, `lime`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `red`, `teal`, `violet` or `yellow`; not used by image avatars.

contentMotion.zh-CN: 启用头像内容区域的动画。
contentMotion.en-US: Enables animation in the avatar content area.

gap.zh-CN: 文字内容与头像左右两侧的间距，单位为像素。
gap.en-US: Space in pixels between the text and either side of the avatar.

hoverMask.zh-CN: 鼠标悬停时显示的覆盖层内容，覆盖层没有默认样式。
hoverMask.en-US: Overlay content shown on hover; the overlay has no default style.

imgAttr.zh-CN: 传给内部 `img` 元素的原生属性，仅图片头像有效；其中的 `onError` 先于组件的 `onError` 调用。
imgAttr.en-US: Native attributes applied to the inner `img` element, for image avatars only; its `onError` runs before the component's `onError`.

onClick.zh-CN: 单击头像时调用，参数为 React 鼠标事件。传入后头像可以聚焦，按 `Enter` 或空格键会触发点击。
onClick.en-US: Called when the avatar is clicked, with the React mouse event. Once set, the avatar can be focused, and `Enter` or Space triggers a click.

onError.zh-CN: 图片加载失败时调用，不传事件参数。返回 `false` 时保留损坏的图片，不切换为文字回退。
onError.en-US: Called when the image fails to load, without an event argument. Returning `false` keeps the broken image instead of switching to the text fallback.

onMouseEnter.zh-CN: 鼠标移入时调用，参数为 React 鼠标事件。
onMouseEnter.en-US: Called when the pointer enters the avatar, with the React mouse event.

onMouseLeave.zh-CN: 鼠标移出时调用，参数为 React 鼠标事件。
onMouseLeave.en-US: Called when the pointer leaves the avatar, with the React mouse event.

ref.zh-CN: 头像主体元素（`.semi-avatar`）的引用；使用额外边框或顶部、底部标记时，它不是外层包裹元素。
ref.en-US: Reference to the avatar element (`.semi-avatar`); when a border or a top or bottom badge is used, it is not the outer wrapper.

size.zh-CN: 头像尺寸，可选 `extra-extra-small`、`extra-small`、`small`、`default`、`medium`、`large`、`extra-large`，也可以传合法的 CSS 尺寸，如 `10px`。
size.en-US: Avatar size: `extra-extra-small`, `extra-small`, `small`, `default`, `medium`, `large` or `extra-large`, or a valid CSS size such as `10px`.

srcSet.zh-CN: 图片头像的响应式资源集合。

style.zh-CN: 头像样式；使用额外边框、顶部或底部标记时，样式落在外层包裹元素上。
style.en-US: Avatar style; when a border or a top or bottom badge is used, the style goes to the outer wrapper.

topSlot.zh-CN: 顶部标记配置，包含 `text`、`gradientStart`、`gradientEnd`、`textColor`、`className` 和 `style`；传入 `render` 时完全由它渲染。仅在圆形且预设尺寸为 `extra-small` 至 `extra-large` 时显示，渐变色未设置时使用 `var(--semi-color-primary)`。
topSlot.en-US: Top badge configuration: `text`, `gradientStart`, `gradientEnd`, `textColor`, `className` and `style`; a `render` function replaces the whole badge. Shown only for circle avatars at the preset sizes from `extra-small` to `extra-large`; an unset gradient color uses `var(--semi-color-primary)`.

maxCount.zh-CN: 显示的最大头像数，超出后显示 `+N` 标签。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of visible avatars; overflow is shown as a `+N` label.

overlapFrom.zh-CN: 头像重叠方向，可选 `start` 或 `end`：`start` 时左边的头像覆盖右边，`end` 时右边的头像覆盖左边。
overlapFrom.en-US: Avatar overlap direction, `start` or `end`: with `start` the left avatar covers the right one, with `end` the right avatar covers the left one.

renderMore.zh-CN: 自定义溢出标签。调用时传入剩余数量和被隐藏的头像节点数组，返回的内容替代默认的 `+N`。
renderMore.en-US: Custom overflow label. It receives the remaining count and the hidden avatar nodes, and its result replaces the default `+N`.

shape.zh-CN: 组内头像的形状，可选 `circle` 或 `square`。
shape.en-US: Shape of the avatars in the group: `circle` or `square`.

size.zh-CN: 组内头像的尺寸，取值同 Avatar 的 `size`。
size.en-US: Size of the avatars in the group, with the same values as the Avatar `size`.
